releases.release_notes: Version 2.2.4 removes corrupted punctuation from the missing-information and Administration interfaces and keeps the complete report closing/signature block together across page boundaries in PDF, Preview, Print, and Word output.
Version 2.2.3 completes the customer report workflow with actual-PDF Preview, clearer technician Help and Export pages, consistent empty-section handling, and visual and security improvements.

Version 2.2.2 adds a missing Report Details completeness prompt before Preview, Export, and Print; an option to remove empty report sections consistently from customer output; protected Administration and template management; cleaner technician Help and Export pages; actual-PDF Preview behavior; and UI polish and security improvements.
Version 2.2.1 aligns the Recommendations and Report Closing / Signature sections with the same Metro theme and font colors.
Version 0.2.2 adds local unsaved-report recovery, simplified custom-template Help instructions, and a new What's New section for release changes.

Updated report rendering and template formatting, improved Preview/Word/PDF consistency, added optional technician closing and signature support, and added automatic application update infrastructure.

policy.description: Only one release is production. Downgrades require allow_downgrade=true on the approved target manifest.
